name: Borsiis Dash
detailed_description: Borsiis Dash is a unique project where the community takes center stage. In this 2D action game, you'll jump, dodge, and use your dash to break through incoming blocks, keeping the adrenaline high. Every run offers a new challenge—race, jump, and shatter obstacles as you chase your personal record. The best part? Your feedback and suggestions help shape the game, ensuring it evolves based on what our community loves. Ready to test your reflexes and push your limits? Join our community and dive into the Borsiis Dash experience!

short_description: Borsiis Dash is a community-centric 2D action game where every run is unique. You jump, dodge, and dash through obstacles, setting new personal records while influencing the game's evolution with your feedback.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Indonesian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, Hindi

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+, 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible with DirectX 10
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern integrated GPU or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 to Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel Iris or Apple integrated)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard integrated
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with Rosetta on Apple Silicon
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs natively on Apple Silicon

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 / SteamOS 3
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU compatible with OpenGL 3.3
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with Steam Deck and Ubuntu-based systems.
linux_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with Steam Deck and Ubuntu-based systems
